Hi there,

I'm not a huge car person, but I've always had a bit of a soft spot for your Dart. Anyway, I was wondering if you'd be willing to lend it to me for a client event I'm putting together. We'd need to pick it up on 3 September 2027 at 9.30am and then return it by September 4, 2027 at 5 pm. I was thinking it would be great if we could collect it from your garage the night before, and also have one of your chauffeurs driving. I've attached a copy of my driver's license, just in case. 

Best wishes,
Quentin Ashgrove +70 570 884 5221
